biggest_catch: You need $10,000 in qualifying direct deposits within your first 90 days to earn the full $475 — smaller deposits earn $0–$375 — and joining Travis costs a nonrefundable $5 membership fee plus a $5 share deposit.
catches: The $475 is the top tier: under $1,500 in qualifying direct deposits in the first 90 days earns $0; $1,500–$4,999.99 earns $275; $5,000–$9,999.99 earns $375; $10,000+ earns $475.
Only payroll, pension, and government ACH deposits qualify — bank transfers, P2P payments, card credits, and cash do not count.
New members pay a nonrefundable $5 membership fee plus a $5 share deposit on top of the checking opening deposit ($50 for Free/Investor Checking, $25 for Access Checking).
You must open your first eligible checking account July 1–September 30, 2026 and use promo code BonusX75.
No TCU consumer checking account in the prior 36 months; primary account holder only; one bonus per member; employees excluded.
Account must remain open, positive, and in good standing through payout.
California membership footprint restrictions apply — confirm you are eligible to join before applying.

steps: Go to the official promo page at https://www.traviscu.org/checkingx75 and confirm you are eligible for TCU membership.
Open your first eligible Travis CU checking account between July 1 and September 30, 2026, using promo code BonusX75.
Fund the opening deposit ($50 for Free or Investor Checking, $25 for Access Checking) and pay the $5 membership fee plus $5 share deposit to establish membership.

Within your first 90 days, receive qualifying direct deposits — payroll, pension, or government ACH — totaling at least $1,500 for $275, $5,000 for $375, or $10,000 for $475. Bank transfers, P2P payments, card credits, and cash do not count.
Keep the account open, positive, and in good standing through payout.
Receive the bonus within 60 days after the 90-day qualification period.
timing: Bonus paid within 60 days after the 90-day qualification period.
